workouts.name: MIET 60min
workouts.purpose: More aerobic stimulus per hour when Z2 volume is constrained by life. Masters-friendly.

workouts.name: Z2 endurance 2h
workouts.purpose: Aerobic durability. Cap NP ≤68% MAP — above that it stops counting as Z2.

workouts.name: 20 Min Warm Up
workouts.purpose: Pre-race warm-up. Progressive build to threshold, then short activations to prime the legs.

workouts.name: In the red pursuit intervals (2km)
workouts.purpose: Race-specific 2 km pursuit simulation — sprint start, then decaying power through anaerobic and VO2 zones.

workouts.name: Openers
workouts.purpose: Day before a race or hard test. Opens the legs through to a sprint without accruing fatigue.

workouts.name: Recovery spin
workouts.purpose: Circulation, not stimulus. High cadence, very low load; keep it short when fatigue is high.

workouts.name: Sweet Spot 3×12
workouts.purpose: Sustained sub-threshold volume in build. Lower fatigue cost than threshold, so more per week.

workouts.name: FTP 20-min test
workouts.purpose: Re-establish FTP when threshold targets need recalibrating. FTP = 95% of best 20-min power.

workouts.name: MAP ramp test
workouts.purpose: Re-establish MAP every 6–8 weeks or at a mesocycle start. Fixed rungs (140 W, +25 W/min) — only the ladder's length follows MAP, so retests stay comparable.

workouts.name: Threshold 2×20
workouts.purpose: Bread-and-butter threshold. Even pacing; if rep 2 drops >5 W the day was too fatigued for it.

workouts.name: 2's and 3's
workouts.purpose: Alternating 2- and 3-min efforts at 120–140% FTP with full recoveries. Repeatability above threshold.

workouts.name: VO2 30/30s
workouts.purpose: VO2 stimulus at lower peripheral cost per rep. Use when 4×4 has been overdone, or when targeting repeatability over peak elicitation.

workouts.name: VO2 4×4
workouts.purpose: Default VO2 session. Highest fraction of time at VO2max per minute of work.

workouts.name: VO2 preloaded shorts
workouts.purpose: Advanced VO2 session — only once 30/30s are well tolerated, and never as the first VO2 session of a block.
